extracted.name: Sautéed Spinach
extracted.description: This sauteed spinach recipe is a quick and easy side dish or delicious addition to pastas, frittatas, and more. Find my favorite serving suggestions in the post above!
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, or until fragrant but not at all browned. Add the spinach and salt and cook, tossing, for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the spinach is just wilted.
Remove from the heat and season to taste with lemon juice and freshly ground black pepper.
